# CIn AI Website

This is the website of CIn AI at Federal University of Pernambuco.

Baed on [Allan Lab](https://github.com/mpa139/allanlab) website. This website is powered by Jekyll and some Bootstrap, Bootwatch. We tried to make it simple yet adaptable, so that it is easy for you to use it as a template. Plese feel free to copy and modify for your own purposes.  You don't have to link to us or mention us (but of course we appreciate it).

Go to *aboutwebsite.md*  to learn how to copy and modidy this page for your purpose.
